title: Local demo: Larger of two integers
description:
Development sample. Return the larger integer. Equal inputs return that same value. These are function arguments, not stdin.

| a | b | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | 9 | 9 |
| -2 | -9 | -2 |
| 4 | 4 | 4 |

C++ example:

```cpp
int larger(int a, int b) { return a > b ? a : b; }
```

Rust example:

```rust
fn larger(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
```
reference: int larger(int a, int b) { return a > b ? a : b; }
